children.name: FTFCH110
children.description: H-module orchestrator for TFC11 create customer. Calls FTFCK110 then FTFCL110; trace F791TRAC and errors F7918030.

children.name: FTFCK110
children.description: K-module validator. Initial check via F115L050; party/amount and sys-code helpers; external geography BPOXING0/F791I060.

children.name: FTFCL110
children.description: L-module loader for customer create. Calls ICU0, IMC0, IRP0, ITP0, L030, L140 and related in-repo helpers.

children.name: F115ICA0
children.description: Contract amount helper — in-repo; DB boundary via external CALL variants.

children.name: F115ICU0
children.description: Customer helper (R115ICU0-Customer). Called from FTFCL110.

children.name: F115IMC0
children.description: Main contract helper (R115IMC0-Main-Contract). Called from FTFCL110 and F115L050.

children.name: F115IPA0
children.description: Part amount helper. Called from FTFCK110 and F115L050.

children.name: F115IRP0
children.description: Related party helper. Called from FTFCK110 and FTFCL110.

children.name: F115ISC0
children.description: System code read. Called from FTFCK110 and helpers.

children.name: F115ISR0
children.description: System code relation. Called from FTFCK110, FTFCL110, F115L050.

children.name: F115ITP0
children.description: Party key helper (R115ITP0-Tast-Part). Called from FTFCL110.

children.name: F115L030
children.description: Timestamp helper (R115L030-Set-Timestamp). Called from FTFCL110.

children.name: F115L050
children.description: Initial check gate (R115L050-Initial-Check). Called from FTFCK110; calls IMC0, ICA0, IPA0, ISR0, ISC0, IST0 (some external variants).

children.name: F115L140
children.description: Shadow contract helper (R115L140-Shadow). Called from FTFCL110.

children.name: F115L240
children.description: In-repo helper; see CALL edges in topology.

children.name: F115L280
children.description: Find currency (R115L280-Find-Currency). Called from FTFCK110.
